title: subject_srv.exe (F-Response Subject) Active Network Listener in Memory — TCP 3262
observation: Volatility3 windows.netscan on base-wkstn-01-memory.img shows PID 12528, Owner "subject_srv.ex" (14-char ImageFileName truncation of subject_srv.exe), LISTENING on TCP 0.0.0.0:3262 and TCPv6 :::3262 (Created 2018-09-06 19:37:07 UTC), plus UDP/UDPv6 0.0.0.0:0 sockets owned by PID 12528 created at 2018-09-06 19:37:06, 19:38:09, and 19:38:10 UTC. A separate ESTABLISHED session 172.16.7.11:3262 <-> 172.16.5.50:56722 is present in the same netscan output with PID/Owner unresolved ("-"), on the same listening port as PID 12528.
interpretation: The listening port (3262) and timestamps match the F-Response Subject agent cmdline previously documented for this host family (-l 3262 -v "F-Response Subject"). The unresolved ESTABLISHED session on the same port 3262 from 172.16.5.50 is consistent with a remote controller connecting to this agent — the same controller IP (172.16.5.50) was observed connecting to the F-Response agent on SRL-2018-RD01. windows.pslist returned 0 records this session (PdbSignatureScanner/kernel-symbol resolution failure for this image), so the process cannot be independently confirmed via pslist, and correlate_evidence() returned verdict=ERROR (pyscca/libscca not installed, blocking the Prefetch source). This finding therefore rests on netscan alone and is INFERRED, not CONFIRMED, per the fallback rule (direct artifact evidence without a usable correlate_evidence verdict).

title: WinRM (TCP 5985) Sessions Between 172.16.7.11 and 172.16.5.21 — Possible Lateral Movement Channel
observation: Volatility3 windows.netscan on base-wkstn-01-memory.img shows one ESTABLISHED TCPv4 session 172.16.7.11:56150 <-> 172.16.5.21:5985 (PID unresolved), plus two additional CLOSED sessions from 172.16.7.11 (ports 56148, 56137) to the same 172.16.5.21:5985. The host also listens on TCP/UDP 5985 itself (PID 4/System, WinRM service, created 2018-08-04 16:28:21 UTC).
interpretation: Port 5985 is the default WinRM/PowerShell-Remoting port. An ESTABLISHED outbound session from this host to 172.16.5.21:5985 alongside two prior CLOSED sessions to the same destination/port is consistent with repeated PowerShell remoting connections — a common lateral movement technique (T1021.006). PID attribution is not possible because windows.pslist returned 0 records this session (same kernel-symbol issue as F-sansforensics-002). 172.16.5.21 is not in prd.json known_iocs/suspicious_patterns.
